meta.title: About
meta.description: Discover why BellumAI was built to simplify prospecting for sales teams at IT services firms.

hero.title: BellumAI was built by salespeople, for salespeople at IT services firms.
hero.description: BellumAI was born out of everyday frustrations: time-consuming research, scattered information, accounts that are hard to map.

items.title: The problem wasn't a lack of data.
items.body: We already had access to a massive amount of information. The real challenge lay elsewhere: turning information into decisions.

items.title: We set out to build the copilot we were missing.
items.body: A copilot able to understand our accounts, prioritize signals and recommend the right action, at the right moment.

cta.title: Join the IT services firms that prospect better.
